work: team bootstrap: the queue, the lock, the cycle
method: one mutation at a time, in one process; the file is backed up, mutated, scripts/tests/team-cycle.tests.ps1 is run, the file is restored from the backup and its sha256 compared with the one taken before. RED = the suite failed (exit 1) and named a failing case.
not_mutated: register-nightly.ps1's two refusals (no -Register, not the home PC): removing either would register a real scheduled task on the owner's machine while the test runs.

mutations.name: T1 a task at an owner gate is run
mutations.tests: FAIL  every state has an answer, and the table names all thirteen | FAIL  no run is ever started for a task at one of the owner's gates | team-cycle tests: 67 passed, 2 failed

mutations.name: T2 a lock is stale after one hour
mutations.tests: FAIL  the other machine's fresh lock stops the cycle | FAIL  a lock is stale at six hours and not a minute before | FAIL  the lock this script writes is one it can read | team-cycle tests: 65 passed, 4 failed

mutations.name: T3 a report without a verdict is an approval
mutations.tests: FAIL  'I cannot APPROVE this.' is NONE | FAIL  'approve' is NONE | FAIL  'APPROVED_BY nobody' is NONE | team-cycle tests: 65 passed, 4 failed

mutations.name: T4 a task may be returned three times
mutations.tests: FAIL  returned once it goes back; returned twice it is stopped | FAIL  returned twice, the task is stopped and the report says why | team-cycle tests: 67 passed, 2 failed

mutations.name: T5 the summary is four hundred lines
mutations.tests: FAIL  a long report is cut to forty lines and keeps its END | FAIL  the report is the protocol's, in Turkish, and the queue holds forty lines of each run | team-cycle tests: 67 passed, 2 failed

mutations.name: T6 two tasks may share an area
mutations.tests: FAIL  refused: two tasks in work on one area, or on an area inside the other's | team-cycle tests: 68 passed, 1 failed

mutations.name: T7 a proposal goes straight to work
mutations.tests: FAIL  every state has an answer, and the table names all thirteen | FAIL  a proposal never reaches a worker on its own | team-cycle tests: 67 passed, 2 failed

mutations.name: T8 a run may start agents of its own
mutations.tests: FAIL  a run is capped, fresh, and cannot start agents of its own | team-cycle tests: 68 passed, 1 failed

mutations.name: T9 a dirty worktree is removed
mutations.tests: FAIL  the worktree of a finished task is closed only when it is clean | team-cycle tests: 68 passed, 1 failed

mutations.name: T10 a conflict is left in the integration branch
mutations.tests: FAIL  a conflict leaves the integration branch as it was and says which branch | team-cycle tests: 68 passed, 1 failed

mutations.name: T11 a worker may leave its area
mutations.tests: FAIL  a worker that leaves its area is sent back before anyone inspects it | team-cycle tests: 68 passed, 1 failed

mutations.name: T12 the money cap stops nothing
mutations.tests: FAIL  the cycle's cap stops it: no run is started once the money is spent | team-cycle tests: 68 passed, 1 failed

mutations.name: T13 the other machine's lock is ignored
mutations.tests: FAIL  the other machine's lock stops the cycle before it starts anything | team-cycle tests: 68 passed, 1 failed

mutations.name: T14 the lock is never released
mutations.tests: FAIL  the cycle's cap stops it: no run is started once the money is spent | FAIL  a run past its time is killed, counted as a failure, and the lock is released | team-cycle tests: 67 passed, 2 failed

mutations.name: T15 a run is given its own cap, whatever is left
mutations.tests: FAIL  the cycle's cap stops it: no run is started once the money is spent | team-cycle tests: 68 passed, 1 failed

mutations.name: T16 a failed run is counted as a result
mutations.tests: FAIL  a run that prints no result is a failure, and two of them stop the task | team-cycle tests: 68 passed, 1 failed
